exercises.title: 1. Read a table with SELECT
exercises.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL);
exercises.seedSql: INSERT INTO books VALUES (1, 'The Hobbit', 1937), (2, 'A Wizard of Earthsea', 1968), (3, 'Kindred', 1979);
exercises.task: Select the title and year of every book, in that column order. Sort by year from oldest to newest using ORDER BY year.

exercises.title: 2. Filter rows with WHERE
exercises.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL);
exercises.seedSql: INSERT INTO books VALUES (1, 'The Hobbit', 1937), (2, 'A Wizard of Earthsea', 1968), (3, 'Kindred', 1979);
exercises.task: Select only the title of books published in or after 1960. Use WHERE year >= 1960. Any row order is accepted.

exercises.title: 3. Combine tables with JOIN
exercises.schemaSql: CREATE TABLE authors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, author_id INTEGER REFERENCES authors(id));
exercises.seedSql: INSERT INTO authors VALUES (1, 'J. R. R. Tolkien'), (2, 'Ursula K. Le Guin'), (3, 'Octavia E. Butler'); INSERT INTO books VALUES (1, 'The Hobbit', 1), (2, 'A Wizard of Earthsea', 2), (3, 'Kindred', 3);
exercises.task: Select books.title and authors.name, in that column order. JOIN authors ON books.author_id = authors.id. Sort by books.id ascending.
